title: Personal Space in Relationships
summary: Needing personal space — time alone or with friends — is healthy and doesn't mean love has faded. Partners do well when they keep separate interests too.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
